projectDescription: A CLI utility to add or remove leading zeros from the numeric suffixes of filenames and directory names in a given directory.
keyFeatures: Add leading zeros to filenames with numeric suffixes, with normalization across all files in a directory
Remove leading zeros from filenames with numeric suffixes
Basic (non-normalizing) add mode for naive zero insertion
Configurable number of zeros to add or remove via --number flag
Operates on both files and directories (any entry whose name ends in digits)
Prevents accidental overwrites when a rename would collide with an existing file
Shell completion support for Bash, Zsh, Fish, Elvish, PowerShell, and Nushell
Man page generation at build time via clap_mangen
